'''Pallas''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he resided at the [[Outpost Overseer]] on [[Voss]], where he asked an Imperial to deal with a [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] chief [[Raklann]].<ref name="The Outcast's Game" />
